title: Fix Flow Extension Bim Wasm Artifact Name
description: semio-s-plugin-flow-extension-bim overrode [lib] name to flow_extension_bim, so cargo emitted flow_extension_bim.wasm while the OS plugin builder looks for semio_s_plugin_flow_extension_bim.wasm (package name), breaking jco transpile during framework-os-dev.
summary: Removed custom [lib] name from semio-s-plugin-flow-extension-bim so cargo emits semio_s_plugin_flow_extension_bim.wasm (matching package name and OS plugin builder). Updated wasm-pack package.json/script.ts basenames and fixed OperatorMeta<'_> elided-lifetime warning. Verified cargo build + jco transpile.
